answer: To change the currency for your site (which applies to your course and all paid transactions): Go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click Language & Region, scroll down to Currency, select your currency from the drop-down menu, and click Save. Important: Your site's currency must match the currency in your payment provider account (e.g., PayPal, Stripe) to accept payments.

If you notice changes that appear on your live site are missing in the editor (such as a stray logo), check your site history to locate the last saved version with the changes. You can restore your editor to the version with the changes if you've saved over them. Make sure you're checking the correct page in your editor that corresponds to the page on your live site with the differences. Other possible causes include site collaborators saving over your changes (viewable in site history) or custom code having unexpected results. Follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant to resolve the issue.

Since your site is published and not password protected, try these steps from the documentation: 1) Ensure search engines can index your site by going to your SEO Dashboard > Go to SEO Settings and making sure the 'Let search engines index your site' toggle is enabled. 2) Check if the specific page has a 'noindex' robots meta tag in its code. 3) Check if the page has any 301 redirects (delete them via URL Redirect Manager if present). 4) Reset the page's canonical tag to default in the Advanced SEO tab if you've customized it. 5) Make sure the page is not set to members only. 6) Ensure the page has enough content (at least 250-400 words). 7) Use Google's URL Inspection Tool or the Wix Site Inspection tool to check the index status and diagnose issues. 8) Check Google Search Console for any manual actions against your page. 9) Complete the Wix SEO Setup Checklist to submit your site directly to Google. 10) Request indexing for specific pages using the URL Inspection Tool. Note that it can take time for Google to crawl and index new sites or changes.

Yes. According to Wix documentation, you must upgrade your site to a Premium or Studio plan that supports payments in order to accept payments. Specifically, your Wix site needs to have a Business & eCommerce Premium plan in order to accept payments, which includes manual payment methods like cash on delivery. Without a premium plan, your checkout will display 'Sorry, we are not accepting orders' because no payment methods can be connected.

The 'suspended by your reseller' message for a Google Workspace business email purchased from Wix means either the email subscription has expired or there is a payment issue. To fix it: 1) Go to your Business Email page in your Wix account and check the status of your business email. 2) If it has expired, click Renew Subscription to renew your Google Workspace subscription. 3) If it is still active, go to Payment Methods, click Actions, click Update, click Next, update your card details, and click Update. (If your renewal payment failed, you can also update your payment method in the Premium Subscriptions section of your Wix account.)

Yes. Your Premium plan subscription stays attached to your site, not to a specific domain. Once you add your new domain to your Wix account, you can assign it to the site that has the active Premium plan. According to the documentation, if you own a domain purchased from Wix, you can easily assign it to a site which has a Premium plan. You do not need to change or repurchase your subscription—simply connect/assign the new domain to your existing Premium site (and ensure the domain is assigned to the correct site in your Domains page).

If a 50% off coupon is not applying, check these common causes in order: (1) Promo code link visibility — in your Editor go to Pages & Menu > Store Pages > Cart Page, click the Cart Page element > Settings > Settings tab, make sure the 'Promo code link' checkbox is selected, then under the Design tab > Links color box pick a color that contrasts with the Cart Page background. (2) Coupon dates — go to Coupons in your dashboard, optionally select Expired from the Status drop-down, select the coupon, edit the start/end dates, and click Save. (3) Coupon activation — go to Coupons, optionally select Not active from the Status drop-down, click the More Actions icon next to the coupon and select Activate. (4) Usage limits — go to Coupons, select the coupon, and either deselect the limitation checkboxes (Remove limitations) or edit the total number of uses, then click Save. (5) Extra spaces — coupon codes are not case-sensitive, but an extra blank space makes the code invalid; have the customer copy and paste the code without changes. Note: for manual payment orders, the available coupon count updates only when the order is marked as paid. If the problem persists after these checks, contact Wix support.

To adjust the menu layout on your mobile site, open the mobile editor and click the menu icon, then click Edit Menu and select the mobile menu. Click the Layout icon to adjust the menu items layout and customize how the items are arranged to suit your site's alignment on smaller screens.

To customize the layout of your products in a Grid Gallery, go to the page in your editor containing the gallery, click the gallery, and then click the Settings icon. Click the Layout tab to customize the gallery using these options: General (toggle to stretch the gallery across the browser and set margin size), Product grid (choose Fixed behavior where settings stay the same regardless of screen size, or Responsive where rows and columns adjust to screen size—note Responsive only works when the gallery is stretched to full width), Product images (select how images are displayed), Add to Cart button (choose placement), Product info (choose a product card layout option), Product options (toggle to display only color options or limit color options), and Ribbons (select where the ribbon appears and adjust padding). You can also customize the design in the Design tab (background, product cards, borders, image corner radius, text fonts, etc.) and text in the Text tab (Add to Cart button text, Out of Stock text, etc.).

To troubleshoot your site being unable to provide a secure connection (HTTPS), follow these steps: Step 1 - Make sure your DNS records are correct. If your domain is connected via name servers, ensure your domain host has the correct name servers set and that you have the default A and CNAME records in your Wix account (go to Domains > More Actions > Manage DNS Records). If connected via pointing, ensure your domain host has the A record (Host: @, Value: 185.230.63.107) and CNAME (Host: www, Value: pointing.wixdns.net) set correctly - if both are not updated, your site will not appear secure. If you purchased your domain from Wix, check that default A and CNAME records exist in your Wix account. Step 2 - Wait up to 48 hours for domain propagation if you recently updated DNS records. Step 3 - If you purchased your domain outside of Wix, ensure DNSSEC is not signed with your domain host. Step 4 - Ensure any HTML elements on your site contain only HTTPS code (not HTTP) - edit the code in the HTML element and republish. Note: Older operating systems may fail to recognize modern SSL certificates; update your device's OS if needed. If still unable to view your site securely, submit a ticket with Wix Customer Care.

If your automated emails triggered by form submissions are not sending, follow these troubleshooting steps: 1) Check automation statistics in your dashboard (Automations > hover over automation > More Actions > View email stats) to confirm if the email was sent. 2) Check the recipient's spam folder and whitelist no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com, @automations.ascendbywix.com (if no confirmed reply-to), or your confirmed reply-to email. 3) Verify the recipient's email address is active and subscribed (look for 'SUBSCRIBED' label on contact card). 4) Confirm the recipient's email address is valid. 5) For form-specific issues: verify the form was successfully submitted in the submissions table; ensure the correct form is selected in the automation trigger settings; make sure the form includes an email field (required for 'Send an email' action) and that the field type is set to 'Email'; for old Wix Forms, ensure the email field is synced to your Contact List as 'Email' or 'Email (Main)'; check if the contact has multiple email addresses (emails may go to an additional email rather than primary); and test the automation while logged out of your Wix account to avoid merging test emails with your logged-in contact.

Click the slideshow in the editor, then click the arrows next to the slide number (blue arrows) to navigate to the relevant slide. Once on the slide you want to edit, click 'Change Slide Background' to choose an image, video, color, or gradient. Note: For full-width slideshows, only the Fill Color & Opacity design options are available in the Design panel, but you can still change each slide's background individually using the steps above.

If you are a sole proprietor in the UK and have registered for a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) number and a business bank account, you should choose the Sole Proprietor (United Kingdom) account type, as UK sole proprietors are required to submit a UTR number and a business bank account when setting up Wix Payments. If you haven't registered for a UTR, or possess only a personal bank account, you can choose an Individual account instead.

According to the Google Ads with Wix refund policy, ad credits added to Google Ads with Wix are paid with a monthly subscription or a one-time payment, and these payments are non-refundable. If you pause a campaign, your remaining ad credits remain in your account and can be used to resume the campaign later, but the payments themselves cannot be refunded.

The Right Click Protect app is available from the Wix App Market and prevents visitors from downloading your site content by displaying a copyright message when they right-click. To add it: go to your editor, click Add Apps (or App Market), search for 'Right Click Protect', click 'Add to Site', and optionally click Settings to edit the displayed message. Important limitation: this app does not prevent visitors from using Ctrl+C to copy your content.

Collection limits vary by site type and plan. Free sites in the Wix Studio platform can have up to 10,000 total collection items, while free sites not in Wix Studio are limited to 1,000 collection items. If you upgrade to a Premium or Studio plan, your limit depends on the plan chosen (for example, plans can include up to 500,000 items). Additionally, each individual collection item can store up to 500KB of data across its total fields; this storage limit does not apply to image, document, multi-document, video, audio, or media gallery fields.

Manual (offline) payments do not appear in your payments page automatically. If you're receiving payments using the manual (offline) method, you must mark them as paid before they appear in your Payments page. Go to Payments in your site's dashboard, find the relevant transaction, and mark it as paid; once marked, it will show in the All payments list with its date, customer, product/service, payment method, status, and amount.

To reinstall Wix Blog: 1) Delete the blog by going to Pages & Menu in your editor, hovering over Blog Pages, clicking the Settings icon, then Delete Blog (and confirm). Note: Deleting does not permanently delete your content. 2) Re-add the blog by clicking Add Elements > Blog > Add to Site (or search 'Wix Blog' in the Wix App Market and click Add to Site). Important: Re-adding restores your content but does not restore your settings or re-add additional blog elements (e.g., Post List). For loading issues specifically, the documentation also recommends first opening your blog in an Incognito/Private window and clearing your browser cache and cookies.

To add more menu titles to your site header, use the Pages & Menu panel in your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side, then click Add Menu Item at the bottom to add a link, dropdown, or section, or click Add Page to add a new page (which automatically appears in the menu). You can also drag items to create subpage dropdowns. Since your site menu is typically located in the header, these new items will appear there automatically.

To track this chargeback's status, go to your Wix Payments dashboard and see the status next to the relevant payment. The possible chargeback statuses are: Action needed, Expires in "X" days, Expired, Final, Accepted, Disputed, Lost, or Won.

To customize the text in automated emails (confirmation, cancellation, and reminders) for Wix Bookings: Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard, then click Emails & SMS notifications. Hover over the automation you want to customize and click Edit. For reminder emails only, you can also click Edit next to Timing to adjust when the email is sent. Scroll down to Action 1 and click Edit under 'Create an email' to edit the email template. You can customize existing text elements, add new elements, edit the subject line, and add dynamic values (variables) by clicking + Dynamic Value or + Add Dynamic Value to insert personalized information like client names or service details. You can also edit the sender's name and reply-to email under Manage details. Note that you can only customize certain parts of pre-installed automations to ensure important session information is delivered, and the main image in automated emails is the same as the image selected when creating the service. Click Save when finished, and optionally use Preview & test to send yourself a test email.

To customize your Wix Store Product Page, access the settings by going to your Editor, clicking Pages & Menu > Store Pages > Product Page, then clicking the Product Page element. For layout and image display: click the Layout tab to select a layout, enable Stretch to full width if desired, choose how to display image thumbnails under Show thumbnails, select an Image ratio, choose how images are resized (Crop to same size or Fit to maintain aspect ratios), and enable Zoom on image if available for your layout. For button text: click the Text tab to edit the Add to Cart, Buy Now, Subscribe Now, Out of Stock, and Back in Stock button text. Note that any customizations made to the Product Page affect all products, while changes in the Store Products tab affect only individual products.

To access and remove the Google Maps element in your footer, use the Layers panel: click the Layers icon at the bottom of your editor, then click 'Footer' to find and select the Google Maps element from the list. If the element is hidden behind another element, right-click the covering element and hover over 'Overlapping Items' to select the Google Maps element from the list. If your footer is frozen, click the footer, click the Settings icon, and disable the 'Freeze Footer' toggle to make elements selectable.

To add new bank details to Wix Payments: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, then click Edit Account Details next to Account Details. Enter the new bank details under Bank Details and click Resubmit (or Save). Important: Whenever you make a change, Wix must verify your information, so your account status temporarily returns to Accepting Payments and you cannot receive payouts during this time. Verification can take up to 7 business days; once complete, any accumulated payouts will be sent. Ensure the bank account holder's name matches the Wix Payments account owner name.

To customize your My Wishlist page (where customers view their saved items), access it through your editor's Members Area settings:

**Wix Editor:** Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the Editor, click Members Area, click the My Wishlist page, then click the My Wishlist page in the Editor, click Settings, and customize the page using the available options.

**Editor X:** Click Pages at the top of the editor, click Members Page, click the Member Menu, click Manage and Navigate, select My Wishlist, click the My Wishlist page in the Editor, click Settings, and customize using the available options.

**Studio Editor:** The documentation indicates you can customize the wishlist button states (Add to Wishlist and Remove from Wishlist) by clicking the Product Page, clicking the Plugins icon, clicking Wishlist, then clicking Action Buttons, selecting the Wishlist button, and clicking Design Wishlist Button.

You can also optionally add an 'Add to Cart' button to the My Wishlist page to make it easier for customers to purchase wishlisted items.

A DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error means your browser could not resolve the domain's DNS records, so the site appears down. Since you haven't changed the domain, start with these checks from the Wix Domain Assistant: (1) Make sure your site is published (click Publish in the editor). (2) Confirm your Premium or Studio plan subscription is still Active in Premium Subscriptions. (3) Confirm the domain is assigned to the correct site under Domains in your Wix account. (4) Check the domain hasn't expired or entered redemption (Premium Subscriptions / Domains) and that its status is active via whois.com. (5) Verify the DNS records are correct for your connection method — if connected via pointing, your domain host must have A record Host @ pointing to 185.230.63.107 and CNAME Host www pointing to pointing.wixdns.net; if purchased from Wix, the A record should be 185.230.63.107 and CNAME initial.wixdns.net in Manage DNS Records. (6) Ensure DNSSEC is not signed (Wix does not support DNSSEC or DNS proxies like Cloudflare). (7) Wait up to 48 hours for DNS propagation after any change, then clear your browser cache, flush your DNS, and reload the site. The specific error ID 7809 / opcode QUERY is not addressed in the retrieved documentation. If issues persist after these steps, contact Wix Customer Care.

You can find Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. To connect tools like Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard, find the integration you want to add, click Connect, and follow the instructions to complete the setup.

Since you are receiving form submissions but the automation is not triggering, follow these troubleshooting steps from the documentation: 1) Check the automation summary/statistics in your dashboard to see how many times it has been triggered and view recent activity. 2) Edit the automation and verify that the correct form is selected in the 'Form Submitted' trigger settings, and check that any filters configured on the trigger are passing. 3) Check if the 'Trigger once per person' toggle is enabled in the trigger settings, as this limits the automation to run only once per contact. 4) Verify that no delay was accidentally configured, as this would prevent immediate execution. 5) Note that automations do not run retroactively—they only run for triggers that occur after the automation is activated. Additionally, for Wix Forms automations specifically, confirm the submission appears in your form's submissions table, and if your action requires contact details (like sending an email), ensure your form includes the required email or phone field with the correct field type.

To find the Address section in a room: Go to your site's dashboard, click the Hotels tab on the left, then click the Rooms tab. Click the Edit icon for an existing room type or click Create New to add a new one, then scroll down to the Address section. Click the Show map location toggle to enable the address option, then enter the city, state, country, street address, and zip code. Important: You can only add an address to a room after you've set up your hotel. If you're trying to add an address to your first room and can't find the address section, add the room without the address first and come back to add the address after setting up your hotel.

To resize your gallery in the desktop editor, you have two options: 1) Click the gallery and drag the stretch handles on its edges to make it bigger or smaller. Note: If you cannot resize using the stretch handles, the gallery is likely already set to full width—you can disable this if needed. 2) Click the gallery, click the Stretch icon, and toggle 'Stretch to full width' to Enabled to make it fit your screen, then optionally adjust the Margins slider (limit is 80 pixels) to change space on either side.

Wix offers a 14-day, money-back guarantee for new Premium site plans (which includes Premium Light). If you purchased your plan within the last 14 days, you are eligible for a full refund by canceling the plan within that window. The refund policy does not apply to plan renewals or upgrades of an existing plan. If you cancel within the first 14 days, your plan is immediately deactivated and your payment method is refunded automatically; please allow up to 20 business days for the refund to appear on your credit card statement. If you do not meet the 14-day requirements but believe you deserve a refund, you can contact Wix to have your request reviewed.

To customize automated client emails (confirmation, cancellation, and reminders) in Wix Bookings: 1) Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard. 2) Click Emails & SMS notifications. 3) Hover over the automation you want to customize and click Edit. (For reminder emails only, you can also click Edit next to Timing to adjust when they are sent.) 4) Scroll down to Action 1 and choose what to customize: Manage details (edit the sender's name and reply-to email address), Create an email (optionally switch the template, then click Edit to customize existing elements, add more elements, and for confirmation/cancellation emails optionally include a Calendar invite ICS file), Set email type (pre-installed; not recommended to change), and Set recipients (select Include trigger contact and/or Include additional recipients). 5) Click Save. You can also add variables (dynamic values) to personalize the subject line, preview text, and email content with client-specific data such as name, service price, staff member, or location, including fallback text for when data is unavailable. Optionally use Preview & test to send yourself a test email before saving.

Since you've already checked the automation statistics, continue with these troubleshooting steps for when the automation triggers but the email isn't sent: 1) Check the recipient's spam folder and whitelist no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com, @automations.ascendbywix.com (if no confirmed reply-to), or your confirmed reply-to address. 2) Verify the recipient's email address is active and subscribed (look for a 'SUBSCRIBED' label on their contact card) - emails to inactive contacts won't go through. 3) Confirm the recipient's email address is valid. For form-specific issues, also verify: the form was successfully submitted (check submissions table), the correct form is selected in the trigger settings, the form includes an email field (required for 'Send an email' action), the email field is the correct field type (New Forms: ensure field type says 'email'; Old Forms: ensure it's titled 'Email Field' and synced to 'Email' or 'Email (Main)' in your Contact List), and check if the contact has multiple email addresses (automated emails may go to an additional email rather than the primary one). If testing while logged in, log out first as your login merges test emails under one contact.

To customize the cart page on mobile in the Wix Editor: Click the 'Switch to mobile' icon at the top of the editor, click the Cart Page in the mobile editor, click Settings, and select a placement option for the checkout button (display it only at the bottom of the page or at both the top and bottom). Note: In the Studio Editor, many customizations are available for the mobile breakpoint, but it is not possible to select where to display the Checkout button.

To sell products on your Wix site, you can use Wix Stores, which is an eCommerce platform that lets you create a professional online store. You can add Wix Stores to any template (many designer templates come with it pre-installed). Once added, you can build your store by adding up to 50,000 physical or digital products, display them in galleries, and customize your storefront with options like 'Quick View', product filters, and a 'Buy Now' button. To accept payments, set up secure online checkout by choosing from payment providers that Wix pre-selects for your region (such as credit/debit cards, PayPal, or Wix Payments). You can also set up shipping rates (free, flat rate, by weight, etc.), local delivery, store pickup, and automated tax calculation. Alternatively, if you don't want to set up a full online store, you can add a PayPal 'Buy Now' button to your site (requires a PayPal Business or Premier account) to sell individual products directly to your PayPal account.

To temporarily remove the Quick Action Bar from your mobile site, right-click it in the mobile Editor and select Delete. Note that when you remove the QAB, it removes the details you entered for each action, so if you re-add it later you will need to manually enter the relevant information again.

To change the header background to black when scrolling in Wix Editor: Click the header, click the More Actions icon, then click Change Header Design. Click to edit the Scroll state, then under Fill Color & Opacity choose black as the color for the header.

To create a custom sign-up form for your Members Area: First, ensure you have a Members Area on your site. In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side, then click Signup & Login. Click Member Signup Form (Default), choose Custom Form from the drop-down under 'Which member signup form do your visitors see?', and click Add to Site. In the Studio Editor, click Pages on the left, click Signup (Default), choose Custom Form from the drop-down, and click Add to Site. Once added, click any element on the form to customize it—you can add elements, change/add form fields, design the form (input fields, submit button, background), customize the button text and layout, and change email notification settings. Note: social logins cannot be added to a custom signup form; use the default form if you need Facebook/Google login.

You can customize your Wix Bookings form in three main ways. (1) Set up your default Booking Form: go to Booking Form in your site's dashboard, give it a title/subtitle, choose whether to split or combine the name fields, edit field labels, mark fields as required, and click '+ Add custom field' to add short answer (30 chars), paragraph (255 chars), or checkbox (500 chars) fields, then click Save Form. (2) Create a custom form for a specific service: go to Booking Services in your dashboard, create or edit a service, expand Additional Settings, click Custom booking form, title it, add/remove fields, and Save Form. (3) Customize the design: in the Wix Editor, go to Pages & Menu > Bookings Pages > Booking form page, click the Booking form element, then Settings to adjust Layout (title alignment/spacing), Display (video conferencing badge, default payment options like Buy a Plan / Pay online / Pay in person), Design (general style, form field style, text, button colors/borders/hover), and Text (edit form text fields).

The provided documentation does not contain specific steps for deleting or disconnecting other payment methods to keep Square as your only payment processor. It only notes that connecting other payment providers alongside Square will result in an additional processing fee.

To add a custom text field to your Product Page for shirt personalization (e.g., customer name): Go to Products in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant product or click New Product. Scroll down and click Add Custom Text Field. Enter the title of the text field (e.g., 'What name should we engrave?'). Enter the character limit for the text field. Select or deselect the Mandatory field checkbox (Selected = customer must fill it in; Deselected = can leave blank). Optionally click Add Another to add a second custom text field (you can add up to 2 fields). Click Save. After a customer places an order, you can see what they entered in the Orders tab.

To test orders in Wix Stores, place a test order through your store using the Manual (Offline) Payment method; completed test orders will appear in the Orders tab of your dashboard. You can also make a test purchase before launching your online store to preview the checkout process (available only for Wix Stores).

To refund a payment made through Wix Payments, go to Payments in your site's dashboard, click on the specific payment to refund, and click Refund. Enter the amount to refund (full or partial) and an optional note, then click Refund to confirm. Refunds typically take 3-5 business days to reach the customer's credit card or bank account. Once initiated, refunds cannot be canceled or reversed. The provided documentation does not specify different steps for recurring payments versus one-time payments; the same process applies to payments listed in your Payments section.

To make the home page from your copy site the home page on your current site, first copy the page from the copy site: open the copy site's Editor, click 'Menus & Pages' (or 'Pages & Menu') on the left, right-click the home page and select 'Copy'. Then open your current site's Editor, right-click anywhere and select 'Paste' (or 'Paste & Apply Site Theme' to apply the current site's colors and fonts). Once the page is pasted into your current site, go to 'Pages & Menu' on the left, hover over the pasted page, click the 'More Actions' icon, and select 'Set as Homepage'. Note: If you want to delete your current homepage, you must first set another page as the homepage.

To transfer your Wix domain to another host: Go to Domains in your Wix account, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, and select 'Transfer away from Wix'. After reviewing the info, click 'Transfer Domain', then 'I Still Want to Transfer'. Wix will send a transfer authorization code (EPP code) to your domain's registrant contact email. Once you receive the code, follow your new domain host's instructions to complete the transfer. Important notes: Your Wix site will be disconnected after transfer, and Wix will no longer manage your domain. Transfers can take up to 7 days. ICANN rules prevent transfers within 60 days of purchase, after changing registrant contact info, or after a previous transfer. Your business email will stop working after transfer—you must re-add MX records at your new host. For transfer status updates, contact your new domain host, as Wix cannot track the transfer once initiated.
To unfreeze your header: Click the header in the editor, click the Settings icon, and select a scroll setting other than 'Freezes' (for example, 'Scrolls with site', 'Disappears', or 'Fades out').

To update the image that appears when sharing your site link, you can set an og:image for each page from inside the Editor. Alternatively, you can upload a general social image for your site by going to Settings in your site's dashboard, clicking Website Settings, scrolling down to General social image, and clicking Upload Image (or Update Image to replace the existing one).

Yes, you can change your billing cycle from a 2-year (multi-year) subscription to monthly. Because you are switching to a shorter plan cycle, the change will take effect on the date when your current 2-year cycle ends (it will not switch over immediately). To make the change: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, click Change Billing Cycle, select the monthly billing cycle, click Continue, review your billing information, and click Confirm.

You can create as many sites as you need in your Wix account. There is no fixed limit on the number of sites you can have. If you reach the limit of free sites within your account, you can move old sites to trash or upgrade your sites to Premium. Note that Premium plans are valid for a single site only, so each site that needs Premium features requires its own Premium plan.

To set up a policy agreement checkbox during checkout in Wix Stores: 1) Go to Checkout Settings in your site's dashboard. 2) Click Customize your checkout. 3) Click Policies. 4) Select the policies you want to create and enter the policy text. 5) Click the Policy agreement checkbox toggle to enable it (this requires customers to agree to your policies before completing checkout). 6) Optionally, select a Checked by default setting: Selected means the checkbox is already checked on the Checkout Page; Deselected means customers need to select the checkbox themselves to agree and check out.

You can unpublish your site from either the Wix Editor or your site's dashboard. From the Editor: Open your site, select 'Site' in the top toolbar, click 'Unpublish Site', then confirm in the pop-up windows. From the Dashboard: Go to Settings > Website settings, click 'Unpublish' at the top of the page, and confirm in the pop-up. After unpublishing, you retain access to the editor and can republish at any time by clicking 'Publish'. Note that unpublishing does not cancel your domain or Premium plan, is only available on desktop (not mobile), and once unpublished the site is inaccessible to visitors even via direct URL (they will see a 'Page Not Found' error).

To view invoices for payments you made to Wix (such as site plans and other Wix services), go to the Billing History page in your Wix account. From there you can browse all your payments, use the All Dates and All Sites drop-downs, More Filters, or the Search field to find a specific invoice, and click Export to download your billing history as a CSV. If you are looking for invoices you sent to your customers, go to Invoices in your site's dashboard (or Manage Invoices in the Wix app).

Payouts are placed on hold when there is an issue blocking your payout, such as a failed payout or an unresolved verification issue. The held amount includes the failed payout plus any other available funds that cannot be sent to your bank. To resolve this, click on the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard to see the specific reason for the failure and instructions on how to fix it. Common causes include incorrect bank account details (the bank account holder's name must match the Wix Payments account owner) or the bank account not being able to receive EFT payments (ACH transfers in the US). To correct this: go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, click Edit Account Details next to Account Details, check the Bank Details, correct them if necessary, and click Resubmit. If your account cannot receive EFT/ACH, update to a different bank account that can. Once the issue is identified and resolved, the payout will be added to your next scheduled payout.

To see which PayPal account is currently connected to your site, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and view your current provider credentials before switching. If you have more than one PayPal account, you can switch to your preferred account, and that connected account is the one that will accept payments on your Wix site. Payouts are managed by your payment provider (PayPal), so funds go to the PayPal business account currently connected.

Go to Payments in your site's dashboard. From there, click on the specific payment you want to refund, then click Refund. Enter the amount to refund (and a note if needed), then click Refund again to confirm. You can also do this from the Wix app on mobile by going to Payments, tapping the payment, and tapping Refund.

To enable guest checkout for your pricing plans: Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Checkout tab. Click to enable the Guest checkout toggle. Click Save. Note: Guest checkout is only available for plans that do not include online content and services, and it is only available on the Plans & Pricing page on your site. Visitors who use guest checkout automatically become contacts and receive an email with a link to create a member profile.

In Canada, Wix Payments service fees are: Credit/Debit Card (excluding American Express) 2.9% of the transaction amount + 0.30 CAD; Apple Pay (excluding American Express) 2.9% of the transaction amount + 0.30 CAD. The provided documentation does not specify PayPal fees for Canada.

The Wix Payments verification process may take up to 7 business days after you submit your details (such as a government-issued photo ID and bank statement) for review. Additionally, from the time of your first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process before your account may be suspended.

You can hire a Wix Partner through the Wix Marketplace. The documentation states: 'Discover 100s of talented designers and explore their portfolios at a price that fits your budget. Go to the Wix Marketplace.'

To create an automation for a standard Wix form: 1) Go to Automations in your site's dashboard and click + New Automation, then + Start from Scratch (or search for a suggested automation using a keyword like 'forms'). 2) Click the title to name your automation. 3) In the Trigger section, click Wix Forms (blue icon for new forms). 4) Under Select a trigger, choose either 'Form submitted' (triggers after any or specific forms are submitted) or 'Option chosen on a form' (triggers when a specific choice field option is selected). 5) If you chose 'Form submitted', select which forms trigger it (Any or Specific). 6) Set the Limit frequency (Don't limit, Once per contact, or Once per contact every 24hrs). 7) Optionally add a delay or condition. 8) Choose an action (e.g., send an email, chat message, push notification, or create a task). 9) Optionally add follow-up actions. 10) Click Activate to save and activate. Alternatively, for recommended automations: click the form on your site, click Form Settings, go to the Automations tab, click Create under a recommended automation, customize if needed, and click Activate.

You can offer free shipping when a customer buys over a certain amount by editing an existing shipping rule. Set up (or edit) a Flat Rate, Rate by Weight, or Rate by Product shipping rule for the relevant region, then select the "Offer free shipping when a customer buys over a certain amount" (or "Offer Free Shipping on orders above a specific subtotal") checkbox and enter the price threshold above which shipping becomes free, then click Save. Note: you'll need to set this up for every relevant shipping region, and if you create additional shipping services (e.g. Express Shipping), the checkbox and amount must be selected for each one. Alternatively, for a temporary offer, you can create a Free Shipping coupon and set "Minimum order subtotal" under Apply to with your threshold amount.

According to Wix Payments documentation, once a payout status shows as Sent, the funds should arrive in your bank account within 3-5 business days. Since it has only been 4 days, your payout is still within the normal arrival window. Factors such as the day of the week, the currency, or bank holidays can affect the exact arrival date. If the payout still hasn't arrived after 5 business days from the sent date, you should check your Payouts dashboard for details or contact support.

To add a hamburger menu to your desktop site in the Wix Editor: Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, select Menu & Anchor, then click Hamburger Menus. Click and drag your chosen menu icon onto the page. Note: Hamburger menus are not available in the mobile Editor, and any added on desktop are not transferred to the mobile version of your site.

When you update your bank account details in Wix Payments, Wix is required to re-verify your information. During this verification period—which can take up to 7 business days—your account status temporarily returns to 'Accepting Payments' and you cannot receive payouts to your bank account, though you can still accept payments on your site. If it has been a couple of weeks (more than 7 business days) and your banking information has not been updated, first verify that your bank details are correct: ensure the bank account holder's name matches the Wix Payments account owner name, double-check that you entered the bank account number(s) correctly, and confirm your bank account can receive EFT payments (ACH transfers if you are in the United States). If 7 business days have already passed and you have confirmed the information is correct and matches your bank account details, contact Wix Customer Care so they can investigate the issue further.

If your Wix Email Marketing emails are being marked as spam or not received, follow these steps from the documentation:

1. **Check spam folders**: Ask recipients to check their spam/junk folders. If you use Wix Automations, whitelist these sender addresses: no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com, @automations.ascendbywix.com (if you have not set a confirmed reply-to email), or your confirmed reply-to email address.

2. **Verify recipient status**: Ensure the recipient's email address is active and subscribed (look for a "SUBSCRIBED" label on their contact card). Emails sent to inactive contacts will not go through. Also confirm the email address is valid.

3. **Review delivery statistics**: In your site's dashboard, go to Email Marketing, click the Check stats icon on your sent campaign, and view Delivery Statistics to see bounce rates and identify specific bounced contacts.

4. **Manage bounces**: High bounce rates (hard bounces from invalid addresses or blocked servers) damage your sender reputation. Regularly check bounced emails, correct typos, delete invalid addresses, and never re-add bounced contacts without verifying the address and getting permission. Enable Double Opt-In in your form settings to verify email addresses.

5. **Prevent spam complaints**: Only email people who have explicitly consented. Do not use purchased mailing lists (this violates Wix Terms of Use and can trigger spam traps that restrict your account). Create engaging, value-driven content and maintain a consistent sending frequency (best practices recommend 1 to 5 campaigns per month).

6. **Address Gmail filtering**: Avoid blacklisted sender domains, suspicious phrases, spelling mistakes, corrupted email headers, and suspicious attachments. Ask recipients to add your 'From' email address to their contact lists.

7. **Maintain list hygiene**: Review your mailing list every 6 months and remove anyone you haven't contacted in the past 12 months. Avoid sending to role addresses (e.g., support@) as they can generate spam complaints.

8. **Include unsubscribe option**: Always provide an easy way for subscribers to unsubscribe from your emails.

The 14-day money-back guarantee does not apply to plan renewals. According to Wix's refund policy, the 14-day refund period only applies to new Premium or Studio site plans, not to renewals or upgrades of existing plans. If you do not meet the requirements for the 14-day refund policy but believe you still deserve a refund, you should contact Wix Customer Care and they will review your request.

To get your site indexed and listed in search results: 1) Verify indexing by searching 'site:yourdomain.com' in Google. 2) Publish your site, as search engines only index published pages and changes. 3) Go to your SEO Dashboard > SEO Settings and ensure the 'Let search engines index your site' toggle is enabled. 4) Check that pages are not blocked by 'noindex' robots meta tags, 301 redirects, custom canonical tags, or password protection. 5) Ensure each page has at least 250-400 words of content. 6) Complete the Wix SEO Setup Checklist to optimize keywords, title tags, and meta descriptions, which also submits your site directly to Google. 7) Your sitemap updates automatically; you can also submit individual page URLs to search engines. 8) Add internal links between pages and ensure your content follows Google's E-E-A-T guidelines (Experience, Expertise, Authority, Trustworthiness). Note that it can take time for Google to crawl and index changes.

If your company details documents were denied, verify that your uploaded document meets these requirements: the tax ID/registration number must be visible and clear; the company name must be visible, clear, and match the business details in your Wix Payments account; the document must have been issued within the last 12 months; and it must be in HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, or PNG format (max 10 MB, min 1 KB for PDF / 100 KB for other formats). Additionally, confirm that the Legal Business Name, Shareholder, and VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN entered in your form match those associated with your business bank account, and ensure you uploaded a document proving the validity and ownership of the VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN during registration. For Canadian corporations, if director documents were requested, they must contain the legal entity name and list all registered directors. If the business name was recently changed, upload both the current business registration document and official name change documentation showing the original and new legal business name.

To allow clients to book your services (tours) and accept payments, you must upgrade your site to a Business & eCommerce Premium Plan. On a free Wix site, you can only display your services without enabling bookings. If you already have a site plan that doesn't support Wix Bookings, you can upgrade to a plan that does; when switching to a higher-priced plan, you pay only the difference in price. To upgrade: go to your site's dashboard, click Upgrade, select the plan that suits your needs, choose your subscription period, enter payment details, and submit the purchase.

Billing for Google Ads with Wix works through a monthly subscription model combined with ad credits. Your monthly subscription is billed monthly (before VAT) as a whole for all campaigns you run, and this amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month. Wix takes 15% of your payment for running and optimizing your campaign, while the remaining 85% goes towards your ad credit, which is spent on ad clicks using a pay-per-click (PPC) model. You set a daily spend for each campaign from your total ad credit 'bucket', and this amount is paid up front (not pay-per-click). You can also make one-time payments to purchase additional ad credits on top of your subscription. All payments (monthly subscription and one-time payments) are non-refundable. Ad credits are paid in USD regardless of the currency you use for your subscription, unless you pay in a supported currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY), in which case credits remain in that currency. Invoices can be viewed in the Billing History page of your Wix account and may include VAT based on your billing country.
The provided documentation does not contain information about configuring your website to require customers to have an account before placing orders.

Since you are using default Wix fonts, here are the recommended steps: 1) Different browsers and devices use different rendering engines, and fonts render differently between iOS and Android, which may cause minor appearance differences. 2) If you are using an iPhone (iOS), certain fonts may not be supported - check iosfonts.com to verify if your specific font is supported on iOS. 3) If you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, Wix recommends choosing another similar looking font for your site. 4) If a supported, default font is still not appearing correctly on your mobile device, contact Wix support for assistance.

Wix offers four 2-step verification methods you can enable simultaneously: (1) Wix app - approve login requests via notification on a device recently logged into the Wix app; (2) SMS - receive a 6-digit code by text message; (3) Authenticator app - scan a QR code and enter a 6-digit code from your authenticator app; (4) Email - receive a 6-digit code via email (only common domains like Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail are eligible). When multiple methods are enabled, the default prompt order is: Wix app first, then authenticator app, then SMS, then email. To enable, go to Account Settings > 2-Step verification and click Enable next to your preferred method. During sign-in, Wix remembers your device for 30 days by default unless you uncheck 'Remember this device for 30 days'. Note that social logins (Google, Facebook) do not require a 2-step code. If you don't receive SMS codes, you can click 'Call me' to receive the code by phone, or use Account Recovery options.

Create a standard automatic discount with a minimum quantity requirement: Go to Automatic Discounts in your site's dashboard, click Create Discount, select Standard discount, enter a discount name, select Specific products (or Specific categories) and choose the hats, check the Minimum quantity of items checkbox and enter 3, select Percentage off from the What is the discount? dropdown and enter 20%, then click Save.

To access your site history in Wix: From the Wix Editor, click Site at the top of the Editor, then click Site History. From the Wix Studio Editor, click the Wix Studio logo on the top left, click Site, then click Site History. From your site's dashboard, go to Site & App, scroll down and click Site History. Once there, you can browse through recent revisions, see who made the changes and when they were made, and restore a previous version by clicking the Arrow icon next to the version you want.

To clear your browser cache: First, close all browser windows and tabs, then open a new tab ensuring Wix.com is not open. Then follow the steps for your browser: **Chrome**: Press Ctrl+Shift+Del (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac), select 'All time' from the Time range dropdown, check 'Cached images and files', click 'Clear data', then close and reopen Chrome. **Firefox**: Press Ctrl+Shift+Del (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac), select 'Everything' from the dropdown, check 'Cache', click 'Clear now', then close and reopen Firefox. **Safari**: Press Cmd+, to open Preferences, click the Advanced tab, check 'Show Develop menu in menu bar', click Develop in Safari's menu bar, click 'Empty Caches', then close and reopen Safari. **Edge**: Press Ctrl+Shift+Del (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac), check 'Cached data and files', click 'Clear', then close and reopen Edge. Tip: Before clearing, try opening the site in incognito/private mode to confirm the issue is cache-related.

Yes. According to the documentation, you can start accepting payments on your site using Wix Payments almost immediately, even while your account is still under verification. However, you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account until the verification process is complete. The verification process begins once you've accepted the first successful payment, and you have 30 days from the first transaction to complete account setup/verification; if not completed within 30 days, the account will be suspended.

Yes, you need to purchase the yearly Premium plan first. The free domain voucher is not a discount applied at the plan checkout; instead, it is added to your account as a separate voucher after you complete the initial purchase of a selected yearly or multi-year plan. Once purchased, you can view and claim the voucher on the Premium Vouchers page in your Wix account. You then use the voucher when purchasing a new domain (or transferring a domain to Wix) by going to Domains, searching for your desired domain, and ensuring the voucher is applied in the summary section before submitting the domain purchase. The voucher is valid for 2 months from the date you purchased your plan.

To offer discounted rates when customers pay for a plan, create a package (or membership plan) with a reduced price while setting up your service. Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard, create or edit a service, scroll to the Price and Payment section, click Create New Plan next to Pricing Plans (Memberships & Packages), and select Package. Enter the plan name and description, choose which services are included, then under Price and Duration select One-time payment (or recurring) and enter the package's discounted price. You can also set the package validity period and additional settings like limiting it to one per person.

To change the order of items on your live site from your CMS collection, go to CMS in your site's dashboard (or click CMS in your editor, then Your Collections), click the relevant collection, select the view at the top you want to use, then either add a sort condition (click Sort > + Add a Sort, choose the field and order, click Add Sort) or manually reorder items (make sure Table is selected as the layout type, click the Reorder icon next to an item, and drag it up or down). Finally, click Mirror on Site at the top of the collection and enable the toggle next to 'Mirror item order on the site'. If the steps did not work, check these common causes from the docs: (1) Any sorts you've added to datasets override the order set in the mirrored collection view, so remove or adjust dataset sorts if you want the mirrored order to apply. (2) 'Mirror on Site' cannot be enabled with external collections and Wix Blocks collections. (3) Manual reordering only works when Table is selected as the layout type. (4) If you deleted a collection view that had mirroring enabled, the order on the site reverts to the order in which items were created.

Since your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, your domain host (not Wix) is in control of your domain's DNS records. You must add the Google Workspace TXT verification record directly with your domain host. Log in to your domain host account where your DNS records are managed, locate the TXT record section, and add the TXT record value provided by Google Workspace (from your Google Admin Console under Domains > Manage Domains > Set up Admin Console > TXT verification). Do not attempt to add this TXT record in your Wix account, as Wix does not control the DNS for domains connected via pointing.

Since you have a Recovery Phone Number added to your Wix account, you can recover your account using a one-time SMS code. To do this: Go to the Wix Log In page and click 'Forgot Email?'. Select 'Can't access my login email' and click Next. Enter the email address associated with your Wix account and click Next. Select 'Send me a code to my phone number ending with XXXX' and click Next. Enter the one-time verification code sent to your phone under 'Enter code here' and click Verify. Enter a new password and retype it, then click 'Save New Password'. Tip: After you recover your account, you should change the email address of your account to one that you are able to access.

The option to connect PayPal may not appear if your business location is set to an unsupported region. PayPal is available in over 200 countries, but as of March 7, 2022, Wix no longer supports PayPal payments for any businesses based in Russia. Verify that your business location at the top right of your site's dashboard is set to a supported country. Also, click "See More Payment Options" at the bottom of the Accept Payments page to view all providers available in your location, as PayPal may be listed there. Note that you must have a Business & eCommerce Premium plan to accept payments.

If your pages are published and not hidden but still not appearing on the live site, first confirm you clicked Publish (not just Save) at the top right of the editor. Also ensure you are using a supported browser, as outdated browsers may cause rendering issues between the editor and live site. If the pages still do not appear, follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant to resolve the issue. Note that the site menu automatically displays every page added to your site except for pages you have chosen to hide.

If you haven't received your payout in your bank account yet, first check the expected timeline: after a payout is sent from Wix Payments, it should arrive in your bank account within 3-5 business days (factors like day-of-week, currency, or bank holidays affect the exact arrival date). Before that, payments go through a processing stage that usually takes 2-5 business days. If it's your first payout, it can take an average of 7 days after your first payment to become available, plus 3-5 business days to arrive. Also verify your Wix Payments account status is Active and successfully verified, as payouts are only made to verified, active accounts with an available balance of at least $1. If the payout was sent but hasn't arrived after 3-5 business days, or if it appears as 'Failed' in your Payouts dashboard, click on the payout to see the issue (such as incorrect bank account details or a bank account that cannot receive EFT/ACH transfers). Funds from a failed payout are placed On Hold until the issue is resolved, then included in your next scheduled payout. To fix bank detail issues, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, then Edit Account Details to verify or correct your Bank Details and click Resubmit.

To create custom hours for a staff member in Wix Bookings (which overrides default hours for that staff member):

**Desktop:**
1. Go to **Staff** in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant staff member and click **Edit**.
3. Click **Add Working Hours**.
4. Select a **Start Date** from the field provided.
5. (Optional) Click **+ Set end date** to make the custom hours temporary (useful for holidays or maternity leave cover).
6. Click the **Repeats** drop-down and choose the relevant option.
7. Click to select all relevant days of the week the custom hours apply to.
8. Enter the **start and end times** in the fields provided.
9. Choose the relevant **Location** from the drop-down.
10. Click **Save**.
11. (Optional) Repeat steps 3-10 to create additional custom work hours for the same staff member (useful if they work different hours/locations on different days).

**Wix app:**
1. Go to your site in the Wix app and tap **Manage** at the bottom.
2. Tap **Booking Calendar**, then tap the **Staff** tab.
3. Tap to select an existing staff member.
4. Tap **Add Hours** next to Working Hours, then tap **Continue**.
5. Tap to select the **Start Date**.
6. (Optional) Tap **+ Set end date** to make the change temporary.
7. Tap the **Repeats** drop-down to select how often they work these hours (Weekly, Every 2 weeks, Every 3 weeks, or Every 4 weeks).
8. Select the days the staff member is available to book.
9. Tap to select the **Start Time** and **End Time**.
10. Tap to select the **Location**.
11. Tap **Save** at the top.
12. (Optional) Repeat steps 6-14 to create additional custom work hours.

Note: Changing staff working hours affects appointment services' availability. A summary of the custom hours appears as you fill out the details.

To enable guest checkout for your pricing plans: Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard, click the Checkout tab, and enable the Guest checkout toggle. Note that guest checkout is only available for customers on the Plans & Pricing page, and for plans that include online content and services, visitors need to create a member profile to gain access.

You can manage your booking service categories in the Booking Services tab of your site's dashboard. To create a category: click Manage Categories, then + Add New Category, enter the name, and click Add. To assign a service to a category: select the service, click the Service category drop-down, choose the category, and click Save (note: a service can only be in one category at a time). To reorder: select a category from the drop-down and drag services within it, or click Manage Categories and drag categories to reorder them. To rename: hover over the category in Manage Categories and click Edit Name. To delete: hover over the category, click Delete, then choose to either move its services to another category or permanently delete the category and its services (this cannot be undone). You can also filter your Service List by category using the Categories drop-down and customize which columns are visible using the Customize columns icon.

To block off time for a single staff member: Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click Add or click the time slot you wish to block off on the calendar. Select Blocked Time. Choose the staff member whose time you want to block from the Staff drop-down. (Optional) Enter a Title to explain the reason. Select a start date and time, then select an end date and time. (Optional) Add a note for yourself. Click Block. During these blocked time slots, customers will not be able to book appointments with that staff member.

To delete items from a CMS collection: 1) Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. 2) Click the relevant collection. 3) Select the checkbox next to the item(s) you want to delete (to select multiple items, select the first item, hold Shift, and select the last item). 4) Click Delete. 5) Click Delete again to confirm. Important: If you have the optional Sandbox enabled, you must delete the item in both the Sandbox and Live collections. Before deleting, ensure no dynamic pages or references in another collection are connected to the item, as these links will break once the item is deleted.

Order confirmation emails are sent to the email address set in the Business Info section of your site's settings. To set or change it: go to Business Info in your site's dashboard, scroll to the Location & Contact Info section, enter the desired email address in the Email field, and save. Note that this is a single Email field in Business Info, so the same address is used for store order confirmations; if you also use a merchant account (e.g. PayPal, Stripe), that provider may send its own confirmation to the email associated with the merchant account.

To add funds to your Wix Payments account when issuing a refund, start the refund process first: Go to Payments in your site's dashboard (desktop) or the Wix app (mobile), select the payment, and click/tap Refund. Enter the refund amount and confirm. If your balance cannot cover the refund, you will see an option to add funds. On desktop, click 'Add Funds & Complete Refund', enter your credit/debit card details, and click 'Add Funds & Complete Refund' again. On the Wix app, tap 'Add Funds & Complete Refund', enter the amount to add, tap Continue, enter your payment details, and tap Add Funds. Once the funds are processed, the refund is automatically issued to your customer (it may take 3-5 business days to appear on their statement). Note: To add more than $20,000, contact Wix Customer Care. If you have multiple payment methods, a negative refund balance applies only to a single payment method group.
After you list your products on Google Merchant Solutions, it can take up to 72 hours for Google to approve them before they can appear in your Performance Max Shopping campaign.

To change the order of products in a category: Go to Categories in your site's dashboard, select the relevant category, click and drag the products to the order you want, then click Save. This changes the order wherever that category is displayed on your site. Note: If you're using the Category Page, you can override this dashboard order in the editor by clicking the Category Page, clicking Settings, selecting the Sorting tab, and choosing a different option from the 'Order products by' drop-down.

Yes, additional information may be required. For an individual Wix Payments account, verification requires submitting specific details and documents: your first/middle/last name and date of birth must match your photo ID; correct bank account number(s); a physical address (PO Boxes not accepted) with an address verification document (e.g., utility bill issued within the last 6 months); a Business Description including Doing Business As name, Business Type, and a short description of products/services; and a color copy of your photo ID plus a bank statement uploaded to your Wix Payments Dashboard. During the review process Wix may request further information, and verification can take up to 7 business days. If your account status shows 'Accepting Payments,' you can accept payments but cannot receive payouts until setup/verification is complete; you have 30 days from your first transaction to complete it or the account will be suspended.

Yes — depending on your account status, Wix may require additional information before your business account is fully verified. If your status is 'Accepting Payments', you have connected Wix Payments but have not completed account setup/verification, so you still need to submit the required details. For a business account, the verification checklist requires: personal details (first/middle/last name and date of birth) matching your photo ID; correct bank account number(s); company name and registration number/tax ID matching registered information; Doing Business As name matching customer statements; a physical address (PO Boxes not accepted) plus an address verification document (e.g., utility bill issued within the last 6 months); confirmation that the Legal Business Name, Shareholder and VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN match those on your business bank account; a document proving validity/ownership of the VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN; a business description (Business Type and products/services); and a color copy of your photo ID and a bank statement. During the process Wix explicitly requests further information such as a valid government-issued photo ID and a bank statement, uploaded to the Wix Payments Dashboard. Verification can take up to 7 business days, and you have 30 days from your first transaction to complete setup/verification or the account is suspended. To check your current status, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and look next to the payment method.

If your Premium plan was canceled (for example, after a missed renewal or failed payment), you can simply purchase a new plan by upgrading the site again. If you are having trouble repurchasing after cancellation, unassign the canceled plan from your site and then try to upgrade again. You can also check the status of your subscription by going to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account; if the plan status is not Active/Expired, you must upgrade to a new plan to reconnect your site to your domain.

To restore a selection of collections (projects) from a backup: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, click More Actions at the top, then click Backups. Click Restore next to the backup you want to restore, click the checkbox next to each collection you want to restore, then click Restore [#] Collections. Click Yes, I am sure to confirm you want to permanently override changes made after the backup creation date, then click Restore.

According to the Wix Payments account setup documentation, it is not possible to switch between business types once you select one. If you already selected Individual/Sole Proprietorship, you cannot change it to Partnership/LLC/Corporation/NGO within the same Wix Payments account setup. To use an EIN under the Partnership/LLC/Corporation/NGO business type, you would need to set up a new Wix Payments account selecting that business type (note: the documentation does not describe a process for migrating an existing account, so contacting Wix Customer Care is recommended for options specific to your situation).

To rename a menu item in the Wix Editor, click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Hover over the relevant menu item and click the More Actions icon, then select Rename to change the name of the item on your site menu.

To delete a lightbox in the Wix Editor: 1) Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click Lightboxes. 2) Click the relevant lightbox in the Pages & Menu panel. 3) Click the More Actions icon. 4) Click Delete.

If you deleted something by accident in the current session, click the Undo icon in the top bar of the Editor to revert the change. Note that you can only undo changes made in the current session—if you closed the tab or signed out, you cannot undo it when you reopen the Editor. To restore elements deleted in a previous session, use Site History to access, view, and restore a previous version of your site. Keep in mind that restoring a previous version reverts any changes made since that version, though some components are not affected.

To connect your Instagram business account to your Wix site, you must first have a Facebook account and ensure your Instagram account is converted to a business account and connected to a Facebook page. In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left, search for the Instagram Feed app, and click Add to Site. Select the app on your page, click Settings, then click Connect Business Account. In the Log In With Facebook pop-up, choose your profile, select the Instagram business account you want to use (select only one), and select the Facebook page connected to that Instagram account (select only one). Click Next, review the permissions, click Done, then click OK. If you previously connected a personal account and have issues switching, disconnect it first, clear Wix cookies from your browser, and then reconnect your business account.

You cannot directly migrate or 'update' an existing site from the Wix Editor to the Studio Editor. To use the Studio Editor, you must first switch your account to the Wix Studio platform (via your account, the Wix Studio homepage, or a team invitation). Once switched, your existing Wix Editor sites will remain in the Wix Editor and will not be migrated to the Studio Editor; to take advantage of the Studio Editor's features, you must rebuild your site in the Studio Editor. After switching, you can still create and manage sites using the classic Wix Editor alongside the Studio Editor.

Yes. You can hide a page from your site menu, and your site visitors can still access it if you link to them directly. According to the documentation, 'Your site visitors cannot access hidden pages unless you link to them.' To hide a page: Go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, and select 'Hide from menu'.

To create a duplicate of your site from the dashboard: Go to your site's dashboard, click Home on the left, click the Site Actions icon, then click Duplicate Site. Enter a name for the duplicate site and click Duplicate. Changes made to the copy will not affect your live site. Note: store orders/invoices, contacts/members, email campaigns, third-party app settings, Google Operations logs, and Secrets Manager secrets are not copied to the duplicate.

Email notifications for Wix Inbox and Chat messages are automatically sent to the email address associated with your Wix account. To have website messages go to a different email address instead, you need to add that email as a site collaborator. Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard, click the Settings drop-down at the top right, click Notifications, then click the Profile & team tab. Click + Invite People next to Your team, enter the business/alternative email address, and click Send Invite. The recipient must accept the invite from their email and log in to the Wix account associated with that email. Once accepted, the new email is automatically assigned a Back Office Manager role. Finally, click the toggle under Email notifications to turn on email notifications for that collaborator. Note: The new email address must have a separate Wix account.

It is not possible to switch to a different template on a site you have already created. Instead, you need to create a new site in your account and select a new template. Once you have chosen your new template, you can copy and paste elements and pages from your old site (in the Wix Editor), import media from the Site Files folder in your Media Manager, and transfer your Premium plan and domain to the new site. Note that some features like Site Theme, Design and Layout, Premium Apps, Contacts, Site Members, Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and others cannot be transferred and will need to be set up again on the new site.

To add an anchor in the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Menu & Anchor. Click Anchor under In-Page Navigation, or drag it to the relevant location on your page. Note: It is not possible to add an anchor to your page's footer.

Since you are still in the Editor (current session), click the Undo icon at the top of your Editor, or press Ctrl + Z on your keyboard, to revert the deletion and get the photo back. Note: Undo only works for changes made in the current session; if you close the tab or sign out, you cannot undo it this way and would need to use Site History to restore a previous version.

According to the Wix Editor documentation, Wix Pro Gallery is one of the elements that cannot be copied between sites. When you attempt to copy a page containing a Wix Pro Gallery, the gallery itself (and its images) will not transfer to the target site. For regular elements that contain media files, you should see an option to either 'Upload' (paste and upload files to the Media Manager of the target site) or 'Don't Upload' (paste without uploading), but this does not apply to Wix Pro Gallery. To move gallery content between sites, you would need to recreate the gallery on the target site and upload the images manually to the new site's Media Manager.

If you previously connected an Instagram account (such as a personal account) and are having trouble connecting your Instagram business account, you may need to clear Wix cookies from your browser before connecting. The documentation states: 'If you previously connected an Instagram personal account to the Instagram Feed app, you may need to clear Wix cookies from your browser before connecting.' To open your browser in incognito/private browsing mode to troubleshoot Wix Editor performance issues, use the following keyboard shortcuts for your browser:

• **Chrome**: Press Ctrl + Shift + N (Cmd + Shift + N on Mac)
• **Firefox**: Press Ctrl + Shift + P (Cmd + Shift + P on Mac)
• **Safari**: Press Cmd + Shift + N
• **Microsoft Edge**: Press Ctrl + Shift + N

If the issue does not occur in incognito mode, it is likely a local browser issue (such as cache or cookies) that can be resolved by clearing your browser's cache and cookies.

A 404 error means the page doesn't exist on the server at the URL entered. Since the error occurs on multiple platforms and for other users, browser cache is unlikely to be the cause. Check these common reasons from the docs: (1) the site hasn't been published yet, (2) the URL entered is incorrect, (3) the domain isn't properly connected, (4) the page was deleted or its URL was changed, or (5) users are clicking a cached search-engine link to an old URL. To resolve: reload the page with Ctrl+F5 (Cmd+R on Mac), verify the URL is correct and re-enter it, and if accessing a page other than the homepage, go to the homepage URL first then navigate via a different link. If the store page is a dynamic page and redirects to a 404, check whether a slug change was made, ensure all connected elements are still linked to the page, and if the URL was already published/indexed, make sure a redirect was created. If the problem persists after these checks, contact Wix support.

When you add a new page to your site, a new item is automatically added to your site menu with the page's name. If you need to add an existing page to a horizontal menu (for example, if the menu is set as an advanced menu), click the menu in your editor, click Manage Menu, click + Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel, and choose Site Pages to add the page as a menu item.

To change the preview image (og:image) that appears when sharing your site URL on social media, set an og:image for each page inside the Wix Editor's Social share settings. For X (formerly Twitter), you can also customize the x:image specifically in the Social share section by selecting an image variable or adding an image URL from your Site Files.

To add content to a repeater in the Wix Editor: First, ensure you have added a repeater by going to Add Elements > List and selecting a template. To add elements (like text or images) to the repeater items, simply drag and drop the element onto one item - it will automatically be added to every item to keep the design consistent. You can then customize the individual content (such as text or images) for each item separately. Note that some elements cannot be attached to repeater items. To add more items to the repeater, select the repeater, click Manage Items, then click Duplicate Item at the bottom, and edit your new item as needed.

On iPads and tablets, Wix sites display the desktop version and are cropped within the vertical gridlines of the Editor. If words are off the screen, make sure your content is placed within the vertical gridlines in your Editor. You can also use columns that are responsive to your screen's width to fit your content within most screens.

To adjust the height of a section in the Wix Editor: Click the section in your Editor, then click and drag the 'Adjust section height' handle at the bottom of the section to make it taller or shorter. Note: The smallest size you can make your section is 40px.

To adjust image positioning with the **Editor Toolbar**: Click the image, then type precise horizontal (X) and vertical (Y) values in the toolbar fields and press Enter after each. Use the **Arrange** icon to move the image forward/backward between layers (Bring to front, Send to back, etc.), or the **Align** icon to align it left, center, right, top, middle, or bottom within its container. For multiple images, multi-select them and use the Align or Distribute icons on the toolbar to space them evenly. To adjust positioning with the **Layers Panel**: Click **Layers** on the bottom left of the editor, select the relevant element from the Header, Page, or Footer list, then click and drag it in the panel to change its order, or use keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+↑ / Ctrl+↓ to move forward/backward; Ctrl+Shift+↑ / Ctrl+Shift+↓ to bring to front/send to back). If an image has been moved outside the visible editor area, hover over it in the Layers panel, click the Information icon, and select **Recenter element** to bring it back into view.

To undo the latest change in your site design, click the Undo icon at the top of your Editor, or press Ctrl + Z on your keyboard (Cmd + Z on Mac). Note: You can only undo changes made during your current session; if you close the tab or sign out of your Wix account, it is not possible to undo those changes when you open the Editor again.

To unpublish your site using the Wix Editor: 1) Open your site in the Wix Editor. 2) Select 'Site' in the top toolbar. 3) Click 'Unpublish Site'. 4) Select 'Unpublish' in the dashboard window. 5) Click 'Unpublish' in the pop-up to confirm. Note: Unpublishing does not cancel your domain or Premium plan, and you can republish at any time from the editor by clicking 'Publish' at the top right.
